Tenemu is the word used to refer to modern beer in the nekoverse. It comes from the word for beer invoking the goddess [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tjenenyet Tenenet] in Ancient Egypt.<ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20240429105020/https://www.worldhistory.org/article/1033/beer-in-ancient-egypt/</ref> It refers to beer brewed by baking bread and then fermenting it, and then flavoring with ginger. The resutl is a blood red colored thick beer which has none of the bitterness associated with modern hops flavored beer[[Category:Oldest pages before the refresh]]
